record.notes: Presented by the Ministry of Digital Transformation on 26 June 2024 as a consultation version dated June 2024; comments were invited for three months from publication. The ministry describes it as analytical material, not a public-policy analytical document within the meaning of the Law on Law-making Activity. It was prepared with support from USAID's Cybersecurity for Critical Infrastructure in Ukraine Activity and the Digital Transformation Activity supported by USAID and UK Dev. It builds on the Roadmap for AI regulation developed by the ministry's Expert Committee on AI, and offers voluntary AI labelling of training data, algorithms and decision space through a web form. On 15 June 2026 the ministry reported the first meeting of a joint working group that is to draft a dedicated AI law aligned with EU rules during 2026.

verification.note: Recheck of 17 Oct 2026: re-read the White Paper PDF stored from the ministry's file storage (storage.thedigital.gov.ua, 11 Oct 2026; unchanged on 17 Oct) and the ministry news item stored on 11 Oct 2026, and stored the Cabinet of Ministers' English news item of 26 June 2024 on the government portal (kmu.gov.ua). The PDF confirms the title, the June 2024 date, the consultation status and the three-month comment period, the ministry as author, the non-binding character, the two stages, the tools and the timeline chart; the Cabinet item confirms the presentation and availability on 26 June 2024 and the donor support. The ministry news item carries the date '15 чер.' without a year; the year 2026 follows from its content, which reports events of May 2026. The ministry's English translation of the White Paper could not be stored (its URL answered HTTP 404, and the copy linked from the Cabinet item on cms.thedigital.gov.ua timed out), so english_version is not recorded. Version 1's statement that no bill had been registered in the Verkhovna Rada rested on no stored file and was removed.

changes.date_published: the Cabinet of Ministers' news item (official) shows the ministry presented the White Paper and made it available on 26 June 2024; the PDF itself gives only June 2024
changes.notes: rewritten: the statement on the Verkhovna Rada removed (no stored file); the presentation date and the donor projects now rest on the stored Cabinet item; the three-month comment period, the link to the Roadmap, the voluntary labelling form and the June 2026 working group added

judgment.status_reasoning: The document is a consultation version dated June 2024 that the ministry calls analytical material without legal force; it proposes two to three years without mandatory rules. The ministry's news item of June 2026 still lists the White Paper among the published groundwork and announces a separate AI law to be drafted during 2026. No final version or withdrawal appears in the stored files. 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A ministry's policy paper on how AI will be regulated, with human-rights impact assessment, a sandbox, labelling and a future AI Act-style law; in scope with no note.
judgment.date_reasoning: The PDF gives only the month (Червень 2024); the Cabinet of Ministers' news item, an official source, gives 26 June 2024 as the day the ministry presented the White Paper and made it available, so date_published becomes 2024-06-26.
